name: Desert Druid
summary: A guardian of arid wilderness who crosses sand unhindered, survives heat, assumes vermin forms, and melds into dunes.

featureOverrides.summary: Assume a Small or Medium vermin form as beast shape IV; plant forms are unavailable.
Assume a Tiny or Large vermin form as beast shape IV; plant forms are unavailable.
Assume a Diminutive or Huge vermin form as beast shape IV; plant forms are unavailable.

features.name: Desert Native
features.summary: In desert terrain, add half Druid level to initiative and key exploration skills and leave no trail.

features.name: Sandwalker
features.summary: Ignore movement, Acrobatics, and Stealth penalties from sand and desert terrain.

features.name: Desert Endurance
features.summary: Ignore hot-climate effects and require less food and water as if wearing a ring of sustenance.

features.name: Shaded Vision
features.summary: Become immune to blindness and dazzling and gain +2 on saves against gaze attacks and figment or pattern illusions.

features.name: Dunemeld
features.summary: Become a swirling mass of sand at will with 10-foot land and burrow speeds and enhanced desert Stealth.
